text:
deploybot: preflight alert: prompt/eval gate FAILED for release v2.19.0 (summarizer). Key metric: ROUGE-L down 3.8% vs baseline; 7/45 noisy cases. Promotion blocked. full report: https://internal.redwood/evals/4982468001 :warning:

kira: can you post the top failing prompts? need to evaluate customer impact for release notes.

deploybot: top failures (abridged):
1) "Policy update summary" -> dropped step about data retention
2) "Release notes short" -> omitted billing change line
3) "Oncall handoff" -> introduced repetitive sentence
noisy ids: 4, 16. systemic ids: 1,2.

oscar: last night we merged small perf patch to kv-cache + quant tweak. Anyone reproduced locally?

anya: I ran focused tests: quant tweak qcfg-7 causes omission on the billing line. reverting qcfg-7 locally restores baseline. suspect rounding in fast_matmul.

maria: product: the billing line is customer-facing in release notes. reducing visibility is unacceptable. recommend a short-lived pin to previous serving variant for public release and continue investigation.

kira: ops: we can do a global pin of the summarizer serving tag to prior variant in ~12m. region pins possible but add complexity.
oscar: plan: 1) pin global to restore baseline 2) open RD-8244 for bisect + kernel fix 3) iterate canary with adjusted quant. any objections?
maria: PM ok with global pin. Add a non-technical release note: "Serving variant temporarily adjusted to preserve critical release details; performance improvements to follow."

anya: starting bisect and will link findings in RD-8244.

deploybot: pin command prepared:
/deploybot pin-model --service summarizer --model-tag prior-stable --scope global --reason "preflight regression: summarizer prompt-suite"

kira: executing now. will report when done. :rocket:
kira: pin applied at 4982468018  deploybot queued re-run.
deploybot: re-run complete at 4982468023: preflight PASS (ROUGE-L delta -0.2%). Gate cleared for release; leaving RD-8244 open for root cause.
maria: thanks everyone  I'll update release notes and notify support. keeping thread for post-mortem notes.
